sampling.unit: unique source_id/query_id within dataset; K repeats never count separately
sampling.a: all strict FREE supported by frozen RGB or available immutable native logit decisions
sampling.b: strict FREE with neither available method support; equal total to a where pool permits
sampling.c: POSITIVE; equal total to a where pool permits
sampling.strata: dataset/visit. Match a counts per stratum first without replacement; redistribute shortages to other visits deterministically by largest remaining capacity, retaining shortage receipt
sampling.v11_decisions: all split cached DAV depth at inherited raw cut 0.24403834342956543; immutable v1 logit decisions available only for old eval4. No new logit forwards on train/cal

measurement.native_rays: 256x192 sampled depth pixels intersecting box, not hardware raw beam count; report inside/before/after/invalid separately
measurement.confidence: exact matching official raw confidence PNG, 0/1/2; unavailable remains unknown, not low confidence
measurement.faro: cached fused depth grid pose to RGB pose nearest zbuffer; holes unknown. Surface contradictions may reflect label or FARO registration/reconstruction error
measurement.depth: optical Z and Euclidean ray distance reported separately; all query intersections in RGB camera coordinates
measurement.geometry: image edge/top/bottom proxies only, no semantic ceiling/floor claim; ray axial and physical intersection lengths; rank16 margin, rank15-17 gap and supporting ray lengths

multilabel_rules.label_suspect: native valid ray count<64 OR confidence2 fraction<0.9 when available OR FARO inside pixels>=16; strict FREE native missing=0 is tautological
multilabel_rules.geometry_risk: domain intersects image outer5% border OR domain pixels<64 OR >50% DAV top16 margin rays have physical box intersection<0.10m; structural association, not causal attribution
multilabel_rules.model_error_strong: native all domain beyond exit, native confidence2>=0.9, FARO beyond exit>=0.9 of domain with inside=0, and DAV inside>=16
multilabel_rules.model_disagreement_unconfirmed: native all domain beyond exit and DAV inside>=16 but strong independent-empty rule not satisfied
multilabel_rules.fusion_only: logit support true, frozen RGB support false; DAV inside<16 explicitly separates fusion output from RGB intrusion
multilabel_rules.unresolved: none of label_suspect/geometry_risk/model_error_strong; supplementary disagreements do not establish cause

decision_check: Controls determine enrichment, not raw prevalence alone. One query changes proportion by 1/N. FARO coverage/registration and confidence missingness constrain attribution; percentages may overlap. No diagnostic cut enters any evaluator.
deliverables: each a RGB crop/query projection/native mask and three-source profile
future_reference: draft only for newly constructed future evaluations; never retrospectively relabel consumed eval
